basic_details.job_title: NBT Event Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust, India (राष्ट्रीय पुस्तक न्यास, भारत), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is filling 1 post of Event Officer purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for three months, at a monthly remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 70,000/-. Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in any discipline, 05 years' experience in seminars, conferences and event management, and fluency in English and Hindi. Applications are made online through www.nbtindia.gov.in, and the last date is 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the National Book Trust, India website, www.nbtindia.gov.in. The last date for submitting applications is 7 December 2026. The notice does not list the documents to be attached or describe the steps of the online form.
important_instructions: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the post as advertised, if circumstances so warrant. Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply.

content_sections.heading: About NBT
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India describes itself in the notice as an apex body in publication of books and book promotion in the country. It works under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and its office printed on the notice is at 5 Institutional Area, Phase-2, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy notice prints the following qualification and experience for the Event Officer post: Educational qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Experience: 05 years' experience in Seminars, Conferences, Event Management, organizing and managing large scale B2C and B2B events, International Events, Book Festivals/Literature Festivals etc. Language: Fluency in English and Hindi. Age limit: 45 Years. The notice does not print a date on which age is to be counted, and it does not mention any age relaxation. Only candidates who fulfil these minimum eligibility criteria may apply. For the exact wording of each condition, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Event Officer will receive a monthly remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 70,000/-. The notice does not say how the amount within this range is fixed, and it does not mention any allowances. The engagement is purely on contract basis through a manpower agency, which means the selected candidate is engaged through the agency rather than appointed directly on a regular post. The initial term is three months, and this can be extended as per requirement of the Trust.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBT Event Officer
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the National Book Trust, India website, www.nbtindia.gov.in . The last date for submitting applications is 7 December 2026. The notice does not list the documents to be attached or describe the steps of the online form.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the post as advertised, if circumstances so warrant. Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply.
